changelog:
v3.5.5 — Home Redesign & Hero Fix

• NEW: Top 10 Today row on Home — Netflix-style ranked cards from trending algorithm
• NEW: Personalized Genre Rows — up to 4 dynamic category rows sorted by your most-watched categories
• NEW: Time-of-day greeting on hero (Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening, username)
• Fixed: Hero backdrop image bleeding into Continue Watching row on Fire TV — root cause was Ken Burns scale transform combined with a Fire TV clipping bug
• Removed: Sports banner (reduces Home load time by saving a network call)
• Mobile: Single-tap fullscreen on Live TV, improved grid touch responsiveness, search result tap fixes
